method: Independent binary glTF accessor inspection per mesh node. Rejected degenerate threshold triangle area <= 1e-14 m²; accepted near-zero is >1e-14 and <1e-12 m² only if normals remain valid; tiny nonzero <1e-8 m². Normals invalid if nonfinite or length differs from 1 by >0.01. Texture GPU estimate assumes uncompressed RGBA8 plus complete mip chain; actual driver allocation may differ. Geometry quantities in node-local metric coordinates, exported node transforms are near unit.

summary.doubleSidedMaterialPerModel: one transparent glazing material; opaque surfaces cull back faces
